title: Financeiro
description:
Analista Financeiro Regulatório (Pleno / Sênior) — Simpay (Instituição de Pagamento)

Sobre a Simpay

A Simpay é uma Instituição de Pagamento focada em meios de pagamento digitais e PIX, em transição para operações cada vez mais diretas e reguladas. Buscamos alguém mão-na-massa, extremamente organizado e com rigor regulatório para cuidar do fluxo financeiro diário e das obrigações junto ao Banco Central .

Missão da vaga

Garantir envios diários e periódicos ao BCB com acurácia e pontualidade , manter reconciliações financeiras em dia e apoiar a contabilidade no cumprimento de CCS e integrações APIX , assegurando plena aderência às normas aplicáveis a Instituições de Pagamento.

Responsabilidades (o que você fará no dia a dia)

  • Envios diários ao BCB (via APIX / RSFN, quando aplicável) :
  • Posições de saldo em contas (contas de pagamento, contas de liquidação e correlatas).
  • Fluxos / saldos enviados a participantes responsáveis / liquidantes.
  • Conferência de retornos, logs e reprocessamentos quando necessário.
  • Reconciliação financeira e operacional :
  • Conciliação diária entre core de pagamentos , banco / liquidante, SPI / PIX e razão contábil.
  • Tratamento de pendências (ajustes, divergências, estornos / devoluções) com trilha de auditoria.
  • Apoio à contabilidade em rotinas regulatórias :
  • CCS (Cadastro de Clientes do SFN) : coleta de dados, validação e acompanhamento de envios / retornos.
  • Integrações APIX : suporte funcional às cargas / consultas, evidências dos envios e SLAs.
  • Preparação de dossiês e evidências para auditorias internas / externas e fiscalizações do BCB.
  • Calendário regulatório da IP :
  • Manter o calendário de obrigações sempre atualizado (diárias, mensais, trimestrais, anuais).
  • Sinalizar riscos de prazo, antecipar bloqueios e propor planos de ação.
  • Indicadores e reporting :
  • Consolidar e reportar dashboards de acurácia / pontualidade dos envios , posição de saldos, ageing de reconciliações e status de CCS / APIX.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais para Diretoria (Finanças / Compliance / Operações).

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia em Finanças / Backoffice / Controladoria em fintech, IP, banco, subadquirente ou similar.
  • Vivência com obrigações regulatórias do BCB para IP (ex. : CCS, integrações APIX , posições de saldo, evidências e trilha de auditoria).
  • Excel / Google Sheets avançado (proc-x, Tabela Dinâmica, validações).
  • Noções de SQL para consultas simples em bases transacionais / BI.
  • Atenção a detalhes, raciocínio contábil e disciplina de processos.
  • Comunicação clara para interface com Contabilidade, Operações, Risco / PLD-FT e parceiros.

    • Diferenciais (bons de ter)

  • Experiência com SPI / PIX , RSFN, participantes responsáveis / liquidantes.
  • Familiaridade com normas recentes do BCB aplicáveis a IPs (ex. : Resoluções BCB 429 / 2024, 496 / 2025, 506 / 2025, 507 / 2025 , entre outras).
  • Python para automação de rotinas / checagens e BigQuery / PostgreSQL .
  • Experiência com conciliação de carteiras (cartão, PIX, split, subcontas) e indicadores operacionais (ex. : devoluções / MED, ageing).

    • Competências comportamentais

  • Rigor (99,9%+ de acurácia), senso de propriedade e urgência .
  • Organização, gestão de prazos e visão de processo ponta-a-ponta.
  • Capacidade de documentar bem e sustentar evidências em auditorias.

    • KPIs da função (como mediremos seu sucesso)

  • Pontualidade dos envios obrigatórios (meta : 100% dentro do prazo D+0 / D+1, conforme obrigação).
  • Acurácia dos arquivos / posições (meta : ≥ 99,9% ).
  • Reconciliações concluídas diariamente (meta : 100% D+1 sem pendências críticas).
  • Zero falhas não tratadas em APIX / CCS (meta : 0 incidentes críticos por mês).
  • SLA de resposta a áreas internas / BCB / auditores (meta : ≤ 1 dia útil ).

    • Modelo de trabalho

  • Local : Remoto.
  • Regime : PJ.
  • Disponibilidade para janela operacional de envios / concilições no início do dia.

title: Mechanical / Plumbing BIM Specialist
description:
Overview

ENG (engbim.com) is a BIM company that specializes in hands-on, field-focused BIM services. Founded in 2007, we are a large BIM production service provider with over 5,000 BIM projects completed and a dedicated team of more than 600 staff. We provide MEP Modeling, VDC/BIM Management, Laser Scanning, Scan to BIM, and a broad range of BIM production services to architects, engineers, and owners.

The Role

The BIM Specialist role covers modeling of different trades (MEP), depending on background and project scope. Responsibilities include delivering high-quality modeling with appropriate LOD and QAQC, and working with increasing autonomy in self-management and modeling efforts. A BIM Specialist helps prevent client problems by detecting potential conflicts during information review, modeling, and coordination phases.

Minimum requirements

  • An excellent level of English (spoken and written) is mandatory. Candidates must be able to engage fluently with native and non-native speakers. Candidates without this requirement will NOT be considered.
  • Solid experience modeling HVAC and plumbing in Revit for commercial, industrial, healthcare, and residential construction. This includes process piping, ductwork, sheet metal, mechanical equipment (pumps, AHUs, RTUs, chillers, boilers), and plumbing elements (domestic water, sanitary drainage, gray water, stormwater, medical gases, compressed air lines, pumps, heaters, and hangers).
  • Experience coordinating or clash-detecting through Navisworks (Revizto acceptable but Navisworks prioritized); knowledge of BIM coordination, clash reports, QAQC, and model accuracy.
  • A mechanical or civil engineering bachelor's degree (architects could be considered only if they have extensive experience modeling and coordinating MEP trades themselves).

Desirable/Additional requirements

  • Familiarity with BIM add-ins (e.g., Evolve, SysQue, Fabrication Parts).
  • Experience in conceptual design / BIM Design assist.
  • AutoCAD Plant 3D knowledge.
  • Dynamo/Python knowledge applied to BIM.
  • On-site/field experience.
  • Ability to produce detailed models with real-world fittings and connection types.

Note: If you do not have experience working with Revit in formal jobs, this profile may be hard to consider. Please do not apply if your English level is insufficient.

Work arrangement

Work from Anywhere: Flexibility to work remotely or from a coworking space.

Paid time off: Flexible paid time off policy.

Wellness & Culture: Freedom and responsibility culture, healthy snack allowances, team celebrations and challenges.

Continuous Learning: Programs to develop technical and soft skills.

Work Equipment & Allowances: Equipment and allowances to support your workspace, including home office setup and device upgrades.

Internet Allowance: Monthly internet and related expenses coverage.

Compensation: Highly competitive, with a mix of fixed and variable pay, in USD. Compensation details are competitive and commensurate with experience.

Application note: Ensure your CV is in English, otherwise your application cannot be considered.

Seniority level: Mid-Senior level

Employment type: Full-time

Industry: Construction

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

The Role

As Vendry’s Business Development Manager, you’ll be the frontline force helping brands kick off their search for the right agency partner, helping to craft their marketing strategies in the process. You’ll be responsible for leading our sales efforts with inbound RFP clients—those who have already expressed interest in starting an agency search through Vendry. This is not a traditional outbound-heavy role. Instead, it’s about deeply understanding each client’s needs, pitching our process, running intro calls, managing follow-ups, and ensuring a seamless transition into the matchmaking phase.

You’ll serve as both consultant and salesperson, ensuring that every interested brand sees the value in Vendry’s approach—and ultimately trusts us to guide them through their agency selection journey.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle for inbound agency search clients—from initial inquiry through signed engagement with our partners.
  • Conduct consultative sales calls to understand each client’s marketing needs and present Vendry’s search process.
  • Build and deliver compelling pitch materials and follow-ups that reflect Vendry’s value proposition.
  • Collaborate closely with the Agency Operations team to ensure smooth handoff and client experience.
  • Maintain detailed records in our CRM to track pipeline activity and conversion metrics.
  • Help evolve our sales materials and process based on feedback and performance.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in a sales or client-facing role, ideally in marketing, advertising, or agency services.
  • Proven ability to run structured sales calls and close consultative deals.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and comfortable managing multiple prospects at once.
  • Experience working in a remote environment and using CRM tools like HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Based in Canada and able to work full-time remotely.

Why Join Vendry

Joining Vendry means joining a team at the forefront of transforming how brands find their marketing partners. You’ll work directly with marketers at companies big and small, helping them discover agencies that can take their brand to the next level. We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values creativity, strategic thinking, and initiative.

If you’re a self-starter with a passion for marketing and building relationships, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

    • Additional Information

    The Team

    The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

    Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

    As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

    Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

    Our Commitment

    We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

What You Should Have

  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.

  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling/inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.

  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.

Technology Specifications:

  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space

Nice-to-haves:

Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. As Vendry’s Business Development Manager, you’ll be the frontline force helping brands kick off their search for the right agency partner, helping to craft their marketing strategies in the process. You’ll be responsible for leading our sales efforts with inbound RFP clients—those who have already expressed interest in starting an agency search through Vendry.   • Help evolve our sales materials and process based on feedback and performance.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in a sales or client-facing role, ideally in marketing, advertising, or agency services.
  • Proven ability to run structured sales calls and close consultative deals.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and comfortable managing multiple prospects at once.
  • Experience working in a remote environment and using CRM tools like HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Based in Canada and able to work full-time remotely.

Why Join Vendry

Joining Vendry means joining a team at the forefront of transforming how brands find their marketing partners. You’ll work directly with marketers at companies big and small, helping them discover agencies that can take their brand to the next level. We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values creativity, strategic thinking, and initiative.

If you’re a self-starter with a passion for marketing and building relationships, we’d love to hear from you.

Desenvolver pipelines automatizados para otimizar a entrega de software e cuidar da gestão de carreira de desenvolvedores, além de mitigar riscos e garantir excelência nas entregas.

Experiência com Distribuição e Sincronização de Dados:

  • Desenvolvimento de soluções que sincronizam dados entre diferentes bases de dados, incluindo arquiteturas distribuídas.

  • Uso de filas e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka) para distribuição de dados.
  • Modelagem de dados para escalabilidade e performance.

Práticas de Segurança de Dados:

  • Implementação de criptografia, controle de acesso e conformidade com normas de segurança de dados (LGPD, GDPR).

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Flex is building a finance super app for premium business owners — reimagining every single aspect of the financial workflow and financial services for any entrepreneur. The company has grown revenue 25x+ since publicly launching in September 2023 and is on track to achieve profitability by late 2025. Flex is focused on mid-market businesses ($3 - $100M revenue) that are largely overlooked by existing fintech solutions and reliant on slow and outdated regional banks. We are targeting a ~$1T revenue opportunity that is largely up for grabs.

Flex is a fully remote company and this role can be performed from anywhere.

About the Role

As a Senior Product Designer at Flex, you’ll own high-impact, often ambiguous problems from definition to launch. You’ll design end-to-end experiences that drive meaningful business outcomes and shape the future of our product. You bring a systems mindset, a bias for action, and a commitment to beautiful, scalable design that serves both our customers and our internal teams.

You’ll play a foundational role in defining what design means at Flex — establishing our patterns, raising our bar for craft, and turning bold ideas into products that make running a business simpler and more intuitive. At Flex, we care about clarity, simplicity, and designing for real humans with real constraints. As part of this journey, you’ll help define how design shapes the future of financial tools.

What You’ll Do

  • Design experiences that make life simpler for business owners, turning Flex’s core hypothesis into products people love.
  • Own and evolve internal tools that make our team faster, more efficient, and more connected.
  • Define the design culture at Flex — set the tone, shape the systems, and establish standards that scale.
  • Partner directly with leadership, including the Head of Product and CEO, to translate vision into tangible, high-impact experiences.
  • Work from zero to one: clarify ambiguous problems, define scope, and deliver polished, functional design.
  • Collaborate deeply with engineering and product partners to ship fast without compromising quality.
  • Champion simplicity and coherence, ensuring every product surface feels connected, intentional, and delightful.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Multi-faceted. You’re a high-level generalist who can tackle a range of challenges — from zero-to-one concepts to system-level refinements.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You seek clarity through collaboration, not waiting for it to arrive. You build artifacts and frameworks that help define what products and features should become.
  • Driven and resilient. You thrive in fast-paced, high-intensity environments. You see pressure as fuel and believe that great work emerges from deep focus and ownership.
  • Collaborative to your core. You communicate early and often, working as one team with product, engineering, and leadership to move in the same direction.
  • Thoughtful and opinionated. You have taste — and the conviction to advocate for it — while staying open to feedback and iteration.
  • Mission-oriented. You care deeply about helping business owners succeed, and you bring that empathy to every decision you make.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and shipping digital products end-to-end. A sharp eye for craft, detail, and delight — you care about the last 10%. Experience building, using, and evolving design systems that scale across teams.
  • Comfort with ambiguity — you clarify problems, define strategy, and move teams forward.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills that influence across product, engineering, and leadership.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with ambitious goals and high standards.

Nice to Have:

  • Coding experience, specifically React
  • Motion, animation, or interaction design skills
  • Strength in visual identity or brand expression
  • Familiarity with fintech or complex business systems

The salary range for this role is $65,000 - $90,000 a year.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you

At Flex, we value passion, determination, and honesty. Even if you don't fully match the job specifics, we encourage you to apply. Unusual career paths and unique skills can help you stand out. We believe diversity drives our success.

Why Join Us

Flex is growing quickly — you’ll help shape the direction of a product and company with real momentum.

We’re well-capitalized with strong backing and a clear long-term vision.

You’ll work with a sharp, driven team that values autonomy, clarity, and quality.

Join ambitious builders who care deeply about winning together — and having fun while doing it.

Annual team on-sites. From Bogota to Mexico City, the entire Flex team gets together once a year to align and build camaraderie.

title: Analista De Desenvolvimento Pleno/Engenheiro De Dados
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!

Buscamos

Analista de Desenvolvimento Pleno - Engenheiro de Dados

Resumo

Buscamos uma pessoa com um conhecimento em engenharia e análise de dados, principalmente voltada para soluções na Azure. Trabalhará com plataformas e aplicações disponíveis na Kantar e a principal responsabilidade é planejar e desenvolver soluções desde a arquitetura até a entrega (desde a arquitetura, passando pela ETL e finalizando na visualização dos dados no Power Bi), passando por todas as etapas do desenvolvimento de software.

O que você irá fazer

  • Levantamento e Análise de Requisitos: Entender junto ao cliente quais as necessidades de negócio, propor soluções e documentar essas necessidades através de especificações funcionais;
  • Executar tarefas em todas as fases do ciclo de desenvolvimento (Análise, Design de Arquitetura, Codificação e Deploy);
  • Participar da definição de processos e ferramentas;
  • Participar na elaboração e na manutenção da documentação técnica dos sistemas desenvolvidos;
  • Sustentação das aplicações em produção, visando garantir a estabilidade e disponibilidade destes sistemas.

O que buscamos?

Qualificações fundamentais

  • Sólida experiência como analista ou engenheiro de dados;
  • Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistema da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio dos conceitos de programação (estruturas de dados, lógica de programação, algoritmos, orientação a objetos, etc);
  • Coleta e preparação dos dados (mapeamento de fontes, ETL e limpeza de dados usando Azure Databricks);
  • Análise de dados (exploração, identificação de padrões, criação de dashboards no Power BI);
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de bancos de dados relacional e multidimensional;
  • Conhecimento em consultas a Data Warehouse Hive (HiveSQL);
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento na linguagem PySpark / Python;
  • Experiencia com PowerBI;
  • Conhecimento em Azure Devops (principalmente Repos e CI / CD);
  • Conceitos de metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento (SCRUM e / ou KANBAN).

Qualificações desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento e orquestração de pipelines de dados utilizando ADF (Azure Data Factory);
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados não relacional;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura e aplicações Azure.

Idioma: Inglês intermediário é imprescindível.

O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade / Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua

Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!

Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

    • Additional Information

    The Team

    The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

    Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

    As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

    Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

    Our Commitment

    We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

    We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

    All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Data Analyst II
description:
Overview

Base pay range: $1.00/yr - $1.00/yr

Provide data in response to one-time or recurring requests for reports or analysis. Understand customer objectives and processes; effectively communicate system capabilities and limitations; and deliver available data. Analyze data quality and take corrective action. Analyze impact of system changes to data/reporting infrastructure (support testing and implementation activities). Contribute data and expertise to the success of complex analysis projects.

Responsibilities

  • Extract and manipulate data to solve business problems.
  • Respond to new requests for reports/data: understand customer objectives and processes; review and refine requirements; and communicate estimated hours and timeline to complete.
  • Extract data using Cognos ReportNet, OBIEE Answers, or similar business query interfaces.
  • Extract data directly from relational databases (e.g. Oracle, SQL Server), data warehouses, or other data stores using SQL.
  • Format data for business use in Excel, Access, or similar format.
  • Produce reports manually and through automated scripting; create and maintain scripts and macros used to automate reports.
  • Support application testing for enhancements or system upgrades.
  • Identify and communicate data quality issues or data differences.
  • Scope and deliver data for analytic purposes (data designed for the construction of advanced mathematical models); measure, document, and address data quality issues.
  • Maintain datasets and dataset documentation; contribute knowledge and expertise to the success of the project.
  • Act as liaison between business and IT; collaborate on technical issues that require IT involvement and business priority to fix. Communicate effectively: be concise and precise in written communication.
  • Incorporate best practices in developing intuitive reports to share with a broad audience; describe and document unique aspects or limitations of data to aid understanding. Demonstrate business understanding: develop in-depth knowledge of data associated with multiple lines of business (LOBs), and effectively support the data needs of those LOBs.
  • Demonstrate commitment to lifelong learning and exemplify good teamwork. Proactively communicate with customers and team members; provide excellent customer service by making realistic commitments and keeping them.
  • Work productively on assigned tasks; collaborate effectively with other team members; demonstrate accountability to management and customers for hours spent on assigned tasks.
  • Diligently strive to deliver value in the fewest possible hours and share effective SQL or other data extraction/manipulation techniques with team members; debug problems with report automation or queries; propose and implement remedies.

Qualifications

Other Critical Skills

  • Microsoft Excel - Advanced
  • BI Tools - Advanced
  • SQL - Intermediate
  • Report Automation - Intermediate
  • Data loading, Queries & manipulation - Advanced
  • Communication - Intermediate
  • Management Reporting - Intermediate

Software / Tool Skills

  • Power BI - Intermediate (4-6 Years)
  • Office Suite - Advanced (7+ Years)
  • Excel - Advanced (7+ Years)
  • SQL - Intermediate (4-6 Years)

English Proficiency

  • Minimum Required: Fluent

Required Education

  • Minimum Required: Bachelor

Benefits

This position comes with competitive compensation and benefits package:

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Home Office model
  • Career development and training opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  • Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally known group
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Training & Development
  • Note: Benefits differ based on employee level

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. The Group is guided everyday by its purpose of unleashing human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 55-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group €22.5 billion in revenues in 2023.

Job Details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Analyst
  • Industries: IT Services and IT Consulting

description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Acompanhar a malha de distribuição B2B, identificando e capitalizando oportunidades para aprimorar a produtividade, ampliar a cobertura de distribuição nas regionais e otimizar a lucratividade da operação

  • Forte vivência com dados, bem como planilhas e construção de apresentações executivas
  • Conhecimento sobre P&L e linguagem financeira
  • Habilidade em construir e manter relacionamento com clientes e parceiros internos e externos
  • Perfil analítico para conseguir criar lógicas de análise cross áreas e saber interpretar resultados para gerar planos de ação práticos; capaz de trabalhar com múltiplos projetos ao mesmo tempo
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Tableau e Ferramentas Google será um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para viagens

About Us

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

The Role

As Vendry’s Business Development Manager, you’ll be the frontline force helping brands kick off their search for the right agency partner, helping to craft their marketing strategies in the process. You’ll be responsible for leading our sales efforts with inbound RFP clients—those who have already expressed interest in starting an agency search through Vendry. This is not a traditional outbound-heavy role. Instead, it’s about deeply understanding each client’s needs, pitching our process, running intro calls, managing follow-ups, and ensuring a seamless transition into the matchmaking phase.

You’ll serve as both consultant and salesperson, ensuring that every interested brand sees the value in Vendry’s approach—and ultimately trusts us to guide them through their agency selection journey.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle for inbound agency search clients—from initial inquiry through signed engagement with our partners.
  • Conduct consultative sales calls to understand each client’s marketing needs and present Vendry’s search process.
  • Build and deliver compelling pitch materials and follow-ups that reflect Vendry’s value proposition.
  • Collaborate closely with the Agency Operations team to ensure smooth handoff and client experience.
  • Maintain detailed records in our CRM to track pipeline activity and conversion metrics.
  • Help evolve our sales materials and process based on feedback and performance.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in a sales or client-facing role, ideally in marketing, advertising, or agency services.
  • Proven ability to run structured sales calls and close consultative deals.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and comfortable managing multiple prospects at once.
  • Experience working in a remote environment and using CRM tools like HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Based in Canada and able to work full-time remotely.

Why Join Vendry

Joining Vendry means joining a team at the forefront of transforming how brands find their marketing partners. You’ll work directly with marketers at companies big and small, helping them discover agencies that can take their brand to the next level. We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values creativity, strategic thinking, and initiative.

If you’re a self-starter with a passion for marketing and building relationships, we’d love to hear from you.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

  • SOC 2 Compliance Management: Lead the end-to-end process for achieving and maintaining SOC 2 compliance, including scoping, evidence collection, control implementation, and audit preparation using Vanta's platform
  • Vanta Platform Utilization: Leverage Vanta's AI and automation tools to streamline compliance workflows, monitor controls, and manage vendor risk assessments
  • Continuous Monitoring: Implement and oversee continuous monitoring processes to ensure ongoing adherence to SOC 2 requirements and other relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)

  • Vendor Risk Management: Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards
  • Audit Support: Collaborate with external auditors to facilitate smooth and efficient SOC 2 audits, utilizing Vanta's tools to provide real-time evidence and reporting
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A . está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

  • Se desenvolver em uma trilha de carreira alinhada ao seu potencial;

Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;

  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;

  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro e/ou São Paulo

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: Executivo De Vendas
description:
Sobre a Verzo

A Verzo foi fundada em 2015 com o objetivo de auxiliar os hospitais e prestadores de serviço de saúde a aprimorarem seus resultados financeiros. Iniciamos movidos pelo propósito de ajudar a saúde do Brasil e animados com os desafios que o setor propicia.

Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.

Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.

Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.

Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.

O que fazemos

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.

Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas / bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.

Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.

Prêmios e reconhecimentos

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Fomos honrados com diversos reconhecimentos ao longo de nossa história como os destaques de “Tendência para a Saúde em 2024” pela Revista Medicina S / A em 2024, “Top Latin America HealthTech” pela HeathCare Tech Outlook em 2022, e selecionados pela Endeavor como uma das empresas de alto impacto no Brasil por meio do programa Scale Up Endeavor no mesmo ano.

Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades

Estamos em busca de um Executivo de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe. As principais responsabilidades da posição incluem:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes.
  • Gerenciar funil de vendas de ponta a ponta: prospecção, qualificação, apresentações, propostas e fechamento.
  • Conduzir reuniões de demonstração do produto.
  • Negociar aspectos comerciais e garantir a melhor experiência do cliente durante o processo comercial.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Marketing e Customer Success para alinhar estratégias e melhorar a jornada do cliente.
  • Alimentar e organizar o CRM, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline.
  • Atingir e superar metas de vendas.

Local de trabalho

O trabalho será remoto, permitindo desempenho das funções de onde desejar. Por vezes, haverá necessidade de viagens para eventos e encontros presenciais com clientes.

Regime de contratação:

Contrato PJ.

Requisitos mínimos

Ao liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios, você desempenha um papel crucial no crescimento da Verzo e na melhoria contínua da saúde no Brasil. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para o sucesso dos hospitais parceiros, proporcionando resultados tangíveis e impactando positivamente a qualidade dos serviços de saúde oferecidos.

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em saúde, tecnologia e SaaS.
  • Histórico consistente de atingimento ou superação de metas.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, consultiva e orientada a soluções.
  • Possuir conhecimento do setor de saúde e do segmento hospitalar.
  • Capacidade de lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes e influenciadores de decisão (C-level, gestores e técnicos).
  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas e ferramentas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para participação em eventos e encontros presenciais que envolvam viagens.
  • Imersão no entendimento dos produtos da Verzo e nas metodologias de vendas, com foco em SPICED, SPIN e CHALLENGER SALE.

O que valorizamos

  • Experiência prévia no setor de saúde.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo e orientado a resultados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e de rápido crescimento.
  • Interesse genuíno em gerar impacto positivo no setor de saúde, via inovação, inteligência de dados e tecnologia.
  • Possuir contatos com profissionais do setor e / ou carteira de clientes ativa.

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e explorar como podemos construir uma jornada de sucesso juntos.

Se você está em busca de uma oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a inovação e a excelência na saúde, a Verzo é o lugar ideal para você. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e contribuir com a vida!

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.


THE POSITION

Reporting to Senior Venue Operations Manager, and working alongside the FIFA Tournament & Venue Operations team in Zurich, the Venue Operations Manager is responsible for ensuring that the stadium is delivered in full compliance with FIFA Hosting Requirements and for leading the operational delivery of all FWWC2027 matches and non-matchday activities at the venue.
The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting one Venue Operations Manager for each host city:

  • Belo Horizonte - Estádio Mineirão
  • Brasília - Estádio Nacional
  • Fortaleza - Arena Castelão
  • Porto Alegre - Estádio Beira-Rio
  • Recife - Arena de Pernambuco
  • Rio de Janeiro - Estádio do Maracanã
  • Salvador - Arena Fonte Nova
  • São Paulo - Arena Itaquera

Please apply only if you currently live in one of these cities or can relocate there independently.

The position requires the effective and efficient management of all venue operations, ensuring seamless coordination with FIFA’s functional areas as well as internal and external stakeholders. Key areas of focus include transparency, communication, issue escalation, problem-solving, innovation, and the use of reporting tools to guarantee operational excellence.

The Venue Operations Manager will act as a coordinator, facilitator, and decision-maker at the stadium. Together with the FIFA27 Senior Venue Manager, the FIFA FWWC Lead Venue Management team, and the FIFA27 Head of Operations, this role holds ultimate responsibility for venue event planning, operational readiness, and on-site implementation, in close collaboration with all stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for the operational delivery of each match day and non-match day at the venue.
  • Will liaise with all functional areas including Competitions, Broadcast, Media, Dressing & Signage, Fan Operations, Pitch Management, Partnerships Rights Delivery, Technical Services & Overlay, Stadium Entertainment, Ticketing, Hospitality, Technology, FTI (Football Technology Innovation), Catering as well as other functional areas such as Services (Logistics, Transport, Guest Management) and Safety, Security, Accreditation & Access and Workforce and Volunteer Management, to ensure the smooth, efficient and effective operation at the venue for all constituent groups.

  • Integration of all relevant functional area operational plans into the stadium environment.
  • Risk identification and mitigation across the venue.

  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Contribution to workshops, seminars and meetings with FIFA, FIFA27, Host Country and site authorities.
  • Coordination of policies, requirements and planning with FIFA, FIFA27, Host Country and site authorities.
  • Co-ordination, planning and delivery of official test events.
  • Plan, manage and implement a good quality and cost-efficient on-site support, service and operations for all relevant FIFA departments as well as other stakeholders (i.e. sponsors, service providers, etc.).
  • Organize and lead Stadium Inspection Tours.
  • Full support to functional areas on site visits, activities and post inspection BIM360 follow up.
  • Manage and review the Stadium budget including regular reporting.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 8 years of management experience in multi-purpose arenas, professional sports clubs, or large-scale international sporting events.

  • Excellent communication and crisis management skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure and provide decisive leadership.

  • Strong understanding of health & safety, risk management, and security regulations in stadium operations.
  • Proven track record in managing complex international projects involving multiple stakeholders and authorities.

Skills & Competencies

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

    • Additional Information

    The Team

    The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

    Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

    As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

    Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

    Our Commitment

    We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Alguém que queira aprender sempre, que tope encarar desafios e tenha proatividade. Buscamos uma pessoa que ame trabalhar com educação e tecnologia e que foque em uma entrega de valor para o cliente! O que esperamos de você :

  • Delivering all necessary legal advice, strategic direction and support during the operational phase, tournament time and wind-down phase of the FWWC27.

Advising, alongside the FIFA Legal team in Miami, on the implementation of the legal framework for the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including:

  • Advising on the implementation of the hosting documentation provided during the bidding process for FWWC27, including hosting agreements, host city agreements, stadium agreements, training site agreements, airport agreements, accommodation agreements and related contractual documentation;
  • Supervising the implementation of the guarantees provided by Brazilian government during the bidding process for FWWC27 across topics such as taxation, immigration, employment and customs; and
  • Supporting the Head of Legal and senior management in its discussions with the Brazilian government and CBF and on the establishment of a FWWC27 event law.

Additional specific areas of responsibility include:

  • Drafting and negotiating service provider agreements and any other contracts to be entered into by FIFA27 in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27;
  • Managing any contentious matters and disputes that may arise in connection with FWWC27;
  • Advising FIFA and FIFA27 on employment and labour law matters, including drafting employment and human resources contracts, documentation and policies and dealing with employment and labour law disputes;
  • Managing external counsel; and
  • Supporting brand protection and anti-ambush marketing activities as part of the overall brand protection plan developed by FIFA.
  • Coordinating and working closely with other legal divisions within FIFA in relation to the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including in relation to media rights, TV production, content, music, technology, intellectual property, brand protection, sponsorship, marketing, corporate and institutional matters.

Your profile

  • An experienced and skilled lawyer qualified in Brazil with at least 10+ years of experience either in a top firm, large corporate or sporting organization, with experience advising major multinational organizations on a wide range of legal issues.
  • Experience with Administrative and Regulatory Law, Contractual and Civil Law consultancy, Compliance and Data Protection is desirable.
  • Previous experience of legal experience in the sports industry is desirable, particularly experience with the hosting and staging of major sports events. Candidates with a demonstratable interest in the sports industry and a strong commercial legal background will also be considered.
  • Experience recruiting and managing a team.
  • Keen understanding of the various interests and demands of all key stakeholders of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 and a thorough appreciation of how the actions of FIFA27 could affect those interests.
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA Senior Management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts.
  • Strong IT skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Capacity to advise the business when making key decisions through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, motivational leadership, effective negotiation skills, excellent communication skills and positive relationship-management skills.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines.

  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organization.

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.
