description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.

We are a remote-first, global team that values integrity, progress, empathy, and a strong commitment to security and innovation.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats — supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. This role reports to the Director of IT.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. You should be a strong communicator, fast learner, and able to thrive in a fast-moving, execution-oriented environment.

This role is customer-facing and involves owning the support experience for employees via tools like Slack and Jira. You will manage procurement, onboarding and offboarding of technology, and contribute to the development and documentation of programs, policies and automation to improve efficiency.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite)
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tooling (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki)
  • SSO integration experience (e.g., Okta) and API-based system integrations
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with ability to explain technical concepts clearly
  • Security-minded with basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing/switching) and OSI model troubleshooting
  • Self-management skills with the ability to scope projects and work across multiple teams
  • Experience in a remote environment and a builder’s mindset to create, iterate and scale IT practices

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS, GAM/command-line tooling, and certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace).

Culture & Benefits

We are looking for a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies our values: integrity, accountability, progress, and empathy. Ledn offers a comprehensive total rewards package, remote-work options (up to 180 days worldwide, subject to restrictions), and ownership via shared equity.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value inclusivity and diversity. You may reach out for accommodation requests throughout the recruitment process. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response, and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.

Role Details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Information Technology
  • Industries: Retail

No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Manager Notes:

Candidates MUST be fluent in English.

Candidates MUST be self-starter, someone who will problem solve and seek out answers on their own instead of waiting to ask or waiting on direction from others. Seeking someone who can very much work independently and take initiative on projects/take the lead and connect with leadership within the org. Seeking someone who can communicate effectively with Director/VP level and not be afraid to ask questions or offer ideas/suggestions.

Role Overview:

As Kimberly-Clark continues to evolve its enterprise delivery model, the Portfolio & Governance CoE Lead plays a critical role in ensuring that strategic initiatives are prioritized, resourced, and executed with discipline and transparency. This resource drives portfolio-level visibility, facilitates governance forums, and embeds decision-making frameworks that enable speed and accountability. By aligning investment decisions with business objectives and standardizing execution oversight, the CoE Lead empowers teams to deliver measurable value while maintaining control and clarity across the enterprise landscape.

Core Responsibilities:

The Portfolio & Governance CoE Lead is responsible for shaping and sustaining Kimberly-Clark’s portfolio management and governance capabilities. This role oversees the development of portfolio frameworks, prioritization models, and governance processes that ensure strategic alignment and delivery consistency. Acting as both a strategist and facilitator, the CoE Lead partners with business and IT leaders to manage investment decisions, monitor portfolio health, and guide execution standards. Through structured oversight a P nd continuous improvement, this leader enables informed decision-making, optimizes resource allocation, and reinforces enterprise-wide accountability.

Continuous Improvement : Lead the development and continuous improvement of portfolio management standards and tools by researching industry trends, gathering stakeholder input, and piloting new approaches. Regularly assess tool effectiveness and adapt solutions to meet evolving business demands.

Capability Building : Facilitate governance forums and decision-making processes across the portfolio by organizing meetings with executive leadership, preparing strategic review materials, and ensuring transparent communication of portfolio performance, risks, and opportunities.

Financial Transparency : Partner with finance and strategy teams to ensure alignment of investments with business goals, participating in annual and quarterly planning cycles, developing business cases for new initiatives, and tracking the ROI of portfolio projects.

Portfolio Performance Measurement : Develop and maintain portfolio dashboards and performance reports, leveraging advanced analytics and visualization tools to provide timely, actionable insights for stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Demand Intake & Prioritization : Support prioritization and capacity planning across initiatives by coordinating resource allocation, monitoring project status, and identifying bottlenecks or capacity constraints, with recommendations for corrective actions.

Best Practice Development : Drive adoption of portfolio practices across business and IT teams by leading workshops, developing best practice guides, and managing change communications to foster a culture of portfolio excellence.

Key Deliverables / Value Enabled:

Enhanced Clarity and Accessibility : Comprehensive documentation of IT processes, standards, and tools ensures that all stakeholders have clear and accessible information. This reduces confusion and enhances understanding across the organization

Strategic Portfolio Alignment : Ensures all initiatives are aligned with enterprise priorities, enabling the organization to invest in the right work at the right time.

Governance Maturity: Establishes and maintains a scalable governance framework that drives accountability, transparency, and timely decision-making across the portfolio.

Real-Time Portfolio Visibility : Delivers dashboards and reporting that provide leadership with actionable insights into portfolio health, risks, and performance.

Resource Optimization : Improves capacity planning and resource allocation across initiatives, reducing bottlenecks and increasing throughput.

Cross-Functional Collaboration : Strengthens alignment between business, IT, and finance teams, ensuring shared ownership of portfolio outcomes.

Scalable Portfolio Practices : Enables consistent portfolio execution across departments by standardizing tools, templates, and processes.

Enhanced Compliance : Automated processes can be designed to adhere to regulatory and compliance requirements, ensuring that all activities are performed in accordance with established standards and policies. This reduces the risk of non-compliance and associated penalties.

Required Qualifications:

Portfolio Management Expertise : 10+ years of experience in portfolio management, strategic planning, or governance roles, with a strong understanding of investment prioritization and resource allocation.

Governance Leadership : Proven ability to design and facilitate governance forums, decision-making frameworks, and executive steering committees.

Strategic Alignment : Experience aligning portfolio initiatives with enterprise strategy, ensuring visibility and accountability across the organization.

Analytical & Financial Acumen : Strong analytical skills with experience in budget oversight, financial modeling, and performance reporting.

Stakeholder Engagement : Exceptional ability to engage and influence senior leaders, communicate complex information clearly, and drive alignment across functions.

Tool Proficiency : Expertise in portfolio and governance tools such as TargetProcess,Power BI, Microsoft Project, Planview, or equivalent platforms.

Change Enablement : Experience leading portfolio transformation initiatives and embedding best practices across delivery teams.

Preferred Skills:

Problem Solving / Decision Making: Organized, analytical, and with an extensive attention to detail with a demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies, assess their magnitude, prioritize for resolution, and apply a new perspective to solve complex problems.

Influencing :Organizationally savvy, with good interpersonal effectiveness, influence, and ability to get things done through both formal and informal means. Develop positive relationships, building support and agreement, with business leaders, enablement teams, and project team members to drive consistent change strategies and approaches.

Navigating Change and Ambiguity :Demonstrates resilience by guiding others in adapting to unknown challenges, limitations, and setbacks. Effectively frames, recognizes, and evaluates underlying assumptions and potential changes, assessing their effects on tasks, the teams, and oneself, even when information is incomplete or unclear.

Customer Value Creation: Proactively identifies, recommends, and implements value-added solutions to strengthen relationships within the organization, providing insights on downstream outcomes, and recommending alternative solutions.

Collaboration: Exceptional ability to collaborate, influence, mobilize, and energize key stakeholders and complex cross-organizational and cross-functional teams to implement creative, innovative, best-in-class solutions.

People & Culture :Knack and passion for tuning into unique cultures, needs, and sentiments of impacted stakeholders. Skilled in active listening and cultivating meaningful feedback loops. Listening with compassion and turning insights into action.

Executive Communication & Writing Skills :Able to distill complex data and details to extract and articulate insights and translate them into audience-appropriate messages. Tunes into the needs of the audience to adjust tone and messaging; building and presenting compelling presentations for executives as well as developing detailed materials for employees.

The platform aims to serve as a secure digital banking backbone, supporting real-world transactions, digital asset custody, and blockchain interoperability — with strict architectural and compliance standards aligned to the financial industry.

The system will integrate with third-party providers such as payment rails and KYC services, and there is no legacy or existing banking backend, but there will be future integrations with external banking services.


Job Summary

Looking for competent Staff Back-End Engineers to design and build the platform’s core modules.

These engineers will play a foundational role in creating a secure, scalable, and modular banking infrastructure that manages real financial transactions and workflows. But there is an essential requirement for deep experience in cryptocurrency technologies.

This engineer will own the module responsible for integrating crypto-specific functionalities, ensuring the digital bank’s bridge to blockchain infrastructure is reliable and secure.

  • Implement and manage transactional logic, ensuring consistency, durability, and fault tolerance across distributed systems.

  • Work with workflow/transaction management frameworks such as Temporal (or similar).

  • Collaborate with peers to align on standards, APIs, and design decisions.

  • Uphold a design-first mindset—prototyping and iteration occur after architectural alignment, not as trial-and-error coding.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Experience building or integrating with cryptocurrency platforms (Ethereum / EVM or Bitcoin).

  • Understanding of digital asset custody, wallets, and transaction flows.

  • Familiarity with smart contracts and blockchain transaction management.

  • Ability to bridge between traditional banking workflows and blockchain-based systems.

  • Strong proficiency in Golang.

  • Demonstrated experience with Workflow Management, State Management, and Transaction Management systems.

  • Hands-on experience integrating with enterprise software systems (multi-service, multi-architecture environments).

  • Experience in defining and implementing service architectures, APIs, and endpoints.

  • Ability to independently design, implement, and deliver production-grade systems.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform.

Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches.

In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About The Role

  • Application Security: Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Authentication & Identity: Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves): Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Additional Security Domains: Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.

  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers :

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Build and Refine AI Products

  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

3. Highly Valued Qualifications

  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We\'ll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

  • Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

  • Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast-paced environment where you\'ll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you\'re a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Global Partner Marketing & Operations Manager
description:
360Learning is looking for a Partner Marketing & Operations Manager to architect and scale the next generation of our global partner ecosystem. This is a highly strategic role at the intersection of marketing, alliances, operations, and growth, ideal for someone who wants to build and own the engine behind one of the fastest-growing partner programs in SaaS.

Your mission: turn our partner program into a world-class growth platform. You will design and orchestrate how we communicate, operate, and scale partnerships internally and externally. This means structuring clear, impactful enablement for our internal teams, while also building the marketing motions and engagement strategies that elevate our partners externally. You’ll harness AI agents, automation, and data to improve how we deliver partner intelligence, streamline collaboration, and amplify partner impact across the business.

Reporting directly to the Director of EMEA Alliances and collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and Finance, you’ll be the driving force behind how we structure, market, and shine our partner program. You will also be responsible for scaling a digital-first approach for our Tier 3 partners globally, and have the responsibility for the sourcing and influence growth metrics.

Overview

The following responsibilities and expectations describe what the role does and what is needed to succeed in this position.

Responsibilities

Within 1 month, you will

  • Immerse yourself in our partner ecosystem, understanding our GTM strategy, current partner motions, and the opportunities ahead
  • Audit existing processes, documentation, and partner communications to identify quick wins and strategic priorities
  • Get hands-on with our tech stack (Salesforce, Atlassian tools, Looker, Dust) and explore how AI and automation can elevate partner engagement and enablement
  • Build relationships across Sales, CS, Product, Marketing, and Finance to align on how partnerships can create impact across the business
  • Get familiar with our Convexity culture

Within 3 months, you will

  • Own the narrative: Redesign our internal partner enablement hub (documentation, playbooks, GTM materials, and co-marketing resources) into a strategic asset for revenue teams
  • Build scalable foundations: Define partner program rules of engagement, partner tiering, and system integrator collaboration models that make partnering with 360Learning intuitive and high-impact
  • Operationalize value: Create and roll out a streamlined process for partnership referral fees, ensuring revenue impact is tracked, reported and optimized
  • Intelligence at scale: Deploy AI-powered tools and workflows to deliver real-time partner insights and automate internal communications, increasing productivity across the revenue org
  • Launch an improved partner newsletter and communication cadence, backed by clear engagement metrics and feedback loops

Within 6 months, you will

  • Scale operational excellence: Automate key workflows; from onboarding to content distribution to marketplace updates, making our partner program more efficient and more visible
  • Drive engagement: Launch targeted, data-driven marketing campaigns (high-touch and low-touch) that deepen partner collaboration and generate measurable pipeline influence
  • Be the source of truth: Build a comprehensive partner intelligence layer that helps internal teams act faster, sell smarter, and deliver greater value
  • Shape GTM impact: Partner with Sales and Marketing leadership to design joint initiatives that expand partner-sourced pipeline and accelerate customer adoption
  • Demonstrate a measurable lift in partner engagement (via newsletter open/click rates, shared content, or co-marketing activity) and direct impact on sourcing
  • Launch a scalable digital-first approach to improve the scale and impact of our Tier 3 partnerships

Within 12 months, you will

  • Be recognized as a key partner to the Alliances team for partner enablement and marketing strategy
  • Lead small scale partner campaigns end-to-end with minimal supervision
  • Contribute to the definition of the partner marketing roadmap and influence cross-functional strategy
  • Have taken steps toward owning or influencing the partner operations function in (processes, enablement, tooling)
  • Getting knowledge from Marketing and Ops current available info and processes

The Skill Set

  • 2-3 years of experience in partner marketing, marketing operations, or a related function (SaaS, consulting, or tech ecosystems preferred)
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, with a structured mindset around process, analysis, documentation and operations
  • Hands-on familiarity or strong willingness to learn Salesforce and the Atlassian suite (Confluence, Jira, Trello, Salesforce), and demonstrated understanding and use of AI Agent tools to create efficiency is a bonus
  • Comfortable working with external partners and cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing
  • Self-starter, equally comfortable in operations/process enablement and creative partner marketing execution
  • Fluency in English and French; German is a plus
  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained in the knowledge base

What We Offer

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity
  • Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent.
  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, providing a quick path to impact
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter
  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - Convexity Culture: bit.ly/Convexity_360L and learn about teams, product and processes bit.ly/42H1ggC

The Interview Process

  • Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager
  • Discovery Meeting with our Director of EMEA Alliances
  • Case Study Meeting with our Director of EMEA Alliances and an Operations Manager
  • Clarification Meeting with our Senior Vice President Alliances
  • Culture Fit Meeting with our Chief Revenue Officer
  • Reference checks
  • Offer !

Get ready using our Knowledge Base: bit.ly/42H1ggC

Who We Are

360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.

360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

Learning Includes Everyone.

In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment.

title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers :

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Build and Refine AI Products

  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

3. Highly Valued Qualifications

  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We\'ll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

  • Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

  • Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast-paced environment where you\'ll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you\'re a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers :

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Build and Refine AI Products

  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

3. Highly Valued Qualifications

  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We\'ll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

  • Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

  • Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast-paced environment where you\'ll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you\'re a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We\'ll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

  • Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast-paced environment where you\'ll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Cargo: Coordenador(a) de Suporte Técnico

Descrição da vaga

Missão do cargo: Coordenar a equipe responsável por prover apoio técnico às unidades de produção, com equipe especializada, promovendo segurança e eficiência das operações. Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e motivador, estimulando o engajamento da equipe e o desenvolvimento contínuo dos profissionais. Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Coordenar o suporte técnico de segundo nível para equipamentos dinâmicos, sistemas elétricos, automação e instrumentação, realizando diagnósticos e troubleshooting em falhas complexas, embarcando esporadicamente para atendimento emergencial offshore e mantendo contato próximo com operações para alinhamento técnico contínuo.
  • Planejar e acompanhar ações corretivas e alternativas técnicas para falhas funcionais, atuando junto às equipes onshore e offshore, propondo soluções técnicas viáveis e apoiando na elaboração de planos de ação e priorização de recursos.
  • Atender chamados técnicos via Flow e Greendocs, analisando criticidade e urgência dos chamados, direcionando para resolução técnica adequada, registrando histórico e ações tomadas.
  • Participar de projetos nas fases FEL-1, contribuindo com estimativas de custo e escopo técnico no EVTE e validando viabilidade de execução e integração com sistemas existentes.
  • Representar tecnicamente a área em situações críticas e emergenciais, participando de salas de guerra e interdições, elaborando respostas técnicas para órgãos reguladores e coordenando ações imediatas com stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Gerenciar tecnicamente contratos e fornecedores, desenvolvendo memoriais descritivos (MD), acompanhando entregas pontuais e conformidade técnica, avaliando desempenho e propondo melhorias.
  • Elaborar e revisar TBE (Technical Bid Evaluation) de grandes equipamentos, definindo critérios técnicos de avaliação, comparando propostas de fornecedores, recomendando alternativas mais adequadas ao escopo do projeto.
  • Avaliar e implantar recomendações de segurança e mudanças técnicas, participando da gestão de mudanças, propondo execução de melhorias, garantindo conformidade com normas e diretrizes de segurança.
  • Manter a governança técnica de sistemas de dados offshore, gerenciando o PI System e demais sistemas de monitoramento, garantindo integridade e disponibilidade das informações, promovendo uso eficiente dos dados para tomada de decisão.
  • Gerenciar a governança de turbomáquinas, monitorando desempenho e confiabilidade operacional, garantindo disponibilidade dos ativos críticos, desenvolvendo padrões técnicos e estratégias de manutenção mais eficazes, propondo ações de melhoria, garantindo suporte técnico especializado.
  • Gerenciar OT (Operational Technology), avaliando redes industriais e obsolescência, implementando medidas de segurança cibernética, garantindo integridade dos sistemas de automação.
  • Assegurar a integridade e conformidade legal dos sistemas de rádio e telecomunicações, realizando o licenciamento junto à ANATEL e CINDACTA, conduzindo inspeções de abrangência de sinal VHF/UHF e antenas, executando inspeções de abrangência sonora do sistema PAGA.

Formação acadêmica (graduação se necessário ou curso técnico): Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (preferencialmente Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou áreas correlatas). Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas técnicas ou de gestão será considerado um diferencial.

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória :

  • Diagnóstico e troubleshooting de falhas complexas em:
  • Equipamentos dinâmicos (ex.: turbomáquinas)
  • Sistemas elétricos, automação e instrumentação
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de monitoramento como PI System.
  • Familiaridade com redes industriais e tecnologia operacional (OT)
  • Gestão de contratos técnicos e fornecedores

  • Licenciamento e conformidade legal de sistemas de rádio e telecomunicações (ANATEL, CINDACTA)

title: Operating Partner
description:
Overview

An operating partner is a business leader who works with a company's leadership team to improve the business and create value for shareholders. They are often a key part of a firm's investment strategy and act as a liaison between the firm and its portfolio company. Their responsibilities can include:

  • Advising and coaching — Working with the CEO and management team to provide perspectives and recommendations.
  • Analyzing challenges — Identifying areas for improvement and developing plans to increase efficiency and growth.
  • Creating strategies — Developing plans to increase profits and cash flow, and implement operational best practices.
  • Monitoring performance — Tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) and financial performance.
  • Facilitating value creation — Ensuring the portfolio company has the resources to meet the firm's investment goals.
  • Supporting growth — Assisting with planning, forecasting, and due diligence to support company growth and expansion.
  • Building reporting — Creating simple, consistent reporting that makes it easy to identify when the company is off-track.
  • Leadership — To run a company you must be a leader. Full stop - no excuses. We are looking for Operating Partners who are natural born leaders.

What is the Cache Operating Partner Program?

The Cache Operating Partner Program is your opportunity to partner with Cache as the incoming CEO/COO/VP/GM/President of a newly acquired portfolio company.

Our Operating Partners are experienced leaders and operators currently working within a Software as a Service or Service-Based businesses in a sales, marketing, operations, or key management role. If you have a demonstrable track record of success and are looking to run an internet-based business as its operating CEO/COO/VP/GM/President we’d love to hear from you.

Applying as an Operating Partner puts you in our network for consideration when we acquire new businesses generating $500K-$5M in revenue. Operating Partners should expect excellent and unique compensation packages including equity and/or profit share participation.

Our Strategy

  • Plug & Play Systems — We use our proven playbooks to create and curate a database full of potential customers and invest in bringing value to them on an ongoing basis.
  • Remote Workforce — With a global footprint, we operate with a distributed team covering multiple time zones capable of serving our multinational customer base.
  • Winning Spirit — We bring a creative solutions mindset to problem-solving. No defeat, be optimistic. Pretty much everything is fixable, and most decisions are reversible.
  • Bunts & Singles — Narrow down the market to a specific customer that we can be the best at serving, and grow from there.

Our Thesis

There are intelligent entrepreneurs globally that are adept at identifying and building great software. Once these companies reach product-market-fit, it’s not uncommon for the company to grow beyond the founders’ core competencies.

By infusing capital and adding infrastructure, we can enable businesses to realize their full potential while continuing to scale the revenue profitably.

Our Focus

We seek to minimize risk and maximize returns, meaning we only invest in companies with a clear predictable path to success.

We will consider all types of business software and service companies, and specifically focus on the following:

  • Enterprise Software
  • SMB Software
  • Vertical Market Software
  • Tech Enabled Managed Services
  • IT Consulting
  • Ecommerce Software

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational leadership experience.
  • 5+ years of experience managing direct and/or indirect reports.
  • Extensive knowledge in operations, including resource planning, demand planning, business planning, corporate strategy, communications, leadership, benchmarking, and forecasting.
  • Required skills in market research, analytics, financial modeling, metrics analysis, and presentations.
  • Strong proficiency in Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize workloads and meet time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Must be results-oriented and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, capable of interacting with all levels of associates with tact and diplomacy.
  • Proven ability to protect confidential information.
  • Ability to travel by automobile and aircraft, with the flexibility to be away from home for extended periods.
  • Experience in managing external relations, including identifying, diversifying, building, and maintaining relationships with community organizations and leaders to secure various forms of support and partnerships.
  • Ability to manage solicitations with board members and sponsors, provide outcome reports, and lead cultivation and stewardship activities for charitable endeavors.
  • Unique compensation packages including equity and/or profit share participation.
  • Competitive Health, Dental, and Vision benefits.
  • Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Loose vacation policy.
  • Flexible work hours.

description:
Overview

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Your Experience

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor\'s degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You’ll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised. But you won’t wait for them to be raised, you’ll seek them out, too. We fix and identify technical problems with a pointed focus of providing the best customer support in the industry.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Ajustes e refinamento do conteúdo: Caso sejam identificadas inconsistências ou oportunidades de melhoria, o conteúdo retornará para ajustes por parte da conteudista, seguindo as orientações da DI. Finalização e conclusão da demanda: Com os ajustes finalizados e o conteúdo aprovado internamente, consideraremos a etapa de atualização concluída, encerrando a entrega conforme o escopo previsto no contrato.

title: Principal Consultant – Soc Transformation And Xsiam Deployment
description:
Overview

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Your Experience

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor\'s degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You’ll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised. But you won’t wait for them to be raised, you’ll seek them out, too. We fix and identify technical problems with a pointed focus of providing the best customer support in the industry.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Principal Consultant – Soc Transformation And Xsiam Deployment
description:
Overview

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Your Experience

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor\'s degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You’ll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised. But you won’t wait for them to be raised, you’ll seek them out, too. We fix and identify technical problems with a pointed focus of providing the best customer support in the industry.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

Quem somos

Quem somos :

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.

O que buscamos

O que buscamos :

Como Gerente de Projetos, você trabalhará em colaboração com a equipe do Studio Rx e os times de Projetos e Client Services nos EUA. Diariamente, você deverá monitorar as atividades dos projetos em andamento, identificando e mitigando riscos, além de manter uma comunicação fluída entre todas as equipes envolvidas.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento do plano do projeto: desde o entendimento e definição do escopo / briefing, passando pela estimativa de esforço e elaboração de cronogramas;
  • Alocação de equipe de acordo com habilidades necessárias, experiência e disponibilidade em parceria com o líder técnico da área de execução do projeto;
  • Gerenciamento e monitoramento das atividades diárias do projeto, garantindo o recebimento de todas as informações e materiais para execução das atividades, seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, consolidando as informações em relatórios para a liderança sênior do projeto;
  • Garantir a comunicação entre os times de execução e demais envolvidos no projeto;
  • Esclarecimento de dúvidas quanto ao direcionamento da execução das atividades, interagindo com equipes responsáveis pelo projeto nos EUA;
  • Garantir a execução das atividades de acordo com prazos e tempo estimado, com a qualidade exigida, e seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Elaboração de relatórios de andamento do projeto, e demais relatórios necessários para acompanhamento dos principais indicadores de sucesso das áreas de atuação.

Pré-Requisitos

  • Inglês fluente (escrito e falado), pois trabalhará diretamente com times globais;
  • Graduação em áreas relacionadas à comunicação (Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração, Comunicação Social) ou TI (Processamento de dados, Análise de sistemas, Ciências da Computação);
  • Experiência consolidada com gestão de projetos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência em agências de comunicação / publicidade;
  • Experiência no segmento healthcare (certificação Veeva é um plus);
  • Proficiência em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (Agile, Scrum etc.);
  • Proficiência em sistemas e / ou softwares de gerenciamento de projetos (MSFT Project, Workfront, Jira etc.)
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas usadas por desenvolvedores front-end e de campanhas digitais (Google Web Designer, Doubleclick Studio, GitHub, Adobe Creative Suite etc.).

Informações Adicionais

Modelo de contratação : CLT

Modelo de trabalho : 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho : Das 10h00 ás 19h00

O que oferecemos

  • Vale Refeição / Alimentação via cartão Swile;
  • Assistência médica SulAmérica 100% custeado pela empresa;
  • Assistência odontológica- opcional;
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Gympass;
  • Auxílio Creche para filhos de até 5 anos;
  • Assistência Pet;
  • Auxílio Home Office.

Overview

The Opportunity: Join Avantor as a Director of Strategic Business Development and drive strategic growth across a portfolio of competitively held accounts in the Midwest region.
